limitations: Conference poster candidate intake; not a peer-reviewed full report or raw-data release.
The poster labels a 16-lamb cohort at 115-125 gestational days with FLI support for at least 72 hours; the all-start denominator and per-timepoint n are not reported.
Only group-level medians and IQRs at baseline and 72 hours are printed; no individual values, unit IDs, or complete longitudinal trajectories are available.

The poster describes linear mixed-effects models with time continuous and adjusted for gestational age and sex; the displayed p-values are retained as time-model results, not pairwise baseline-versus-72-hour tests.
The fifth steroid-panel label is printed as Cortol; the poster does not define the analyte further in the text extraction. Preserve the label as printed.
No post-support neonatal transition or developmental follow-up outcome is reported in this poster.
EP09.40 may overlap EP09.20, EP09.31, or EP09.22, but no shared animal/experiment key or study dates establish identity. Do not pool counts or treat reports as independent replications.
